title: When you feel stuck
line: For blocks, delays, or a beginning you keep putting off.
intro: When nothing moves, this tradition turns to Ganesha, the remover of obstacles. This practice asks for a clear way, and for one small first step.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: Sit comfortably, with your back upright and soft. Follow the circle: in as it grows, out as it settles. Never strain.

steps.title: Ask for a clear way
steps.text: May all my work be free of obstacles, always.

steps.title: One small step
steps.prompt: What is one small step I could take today, even five minutes’ worth?

steps.title: Close
steps.text: Read the closing prayer once, slowly. Then sit for one more breath before you return to your day.

after: Begin the step today, however small. Come back tomorrow.
